calibration.format: Explicit list of signal/response pairs;no implicit clockwise=yes
calibration.complete: At least one distinct yes signal and no signal required for any resolved session
calibration.conflicts: Duplicate or contradictory entries rejected;no silent repair
calibration.reserved: Searching,still,partial,conflicting,unknown remain unresolved and cannot be remapped
calibration.source_boundary: Individual mappings are source-permitted;fixed vocabulary,validation and conservative aggregation are application conventions

signals.clockwise: Reported circular motion clockwise from observer viewpoint
signals.counterclockwise: Reported circular motion counterclockwise from observer viewpoint
signals.vertical: Reported to-and-fro motion toward/away from body;calibration or search context required
signals.searching: User explicitly classifies motion as search/neutral
signals.partial: Incomplete movement without a specified full category

observations.unknown_signal: Retain supplied plain-text category as unrecognized;never infer yes/no
observations.aggregation: Unanimous full resolved responses only;any partial,missing,neutral,unknown or disagreement makes session unresolved. No voting or confidence estimate.
observations.source_boundary: Repetition and conservative aggregation are editorial application policy,not a source-verified historical ritual

manual.additional_bound: Irregular signals may map to search/rethink/unresolved;cannot establish full yes/no
